usedFor: webCRM holds organizations, people and opportunities, and Calendly makes a booking link through “Create Scheduling Link” after “New Opportunity Created”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Opportunity Created” in webCRM, then “Create Scheduling Link” in Calendly
bestTemplate.why: A new opportunity gets a booking link made for it.

watchOut: Every webCRM trigger here is polling, so “New Opportunity Created” produces the link after a short delay.
